senses.gloss: a layer of material covering the inside surface of something

definition_translations.ja_JP: 物の内側の表面を覆う素材の層
definition_translations.ko_KR: 어떤 것의 안쪽 표면을 덮는 재료 층

senses.gloss: a row or arrangement of people or things along a line
senses.example: The careful lining of chairs made the room look orderly.

translations.th_TH: การจัดเรียงเป็นแถว

example_translations.zh_TW: 椅子排列得很仔細，讓房間看起來井然有序。
example_translations.ja_JP: 椅子を丁寧に並べたことで、部屋は整然として見えました。
example_translations.ko_KR: 의자를 정성스럽게 줄지어 놓아 방이 정돈되어 보였다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Việc xếp ghế cẩn thận khiến căn phòng trông ngăn nắp.
